why.en: Moving someone else’s funds through your account can expose you to money-mule activity. Pause and verify the employer independently.
why.ms: Memindahkan wang orang lain melalui akaun anda boleh melibatkan aktiviti akaun keldai. Berhenti dan sahkan majikan secara bebas.

why.en: Payroll may require an account number. Using your account to process business funds is different; ask what the account will be used for.
why.ms: Gaji mungkin memerlukan nombor akaun. Memproses wang perniagaan melalui akaun anda berbeza; tanya tujuan penggunaan akaun.

why.en: Commission tied to money movement deserves scrutiny, especially alongside requests to use your own account.
why.ms: Komisen yang berkaitan pemindahan wang perlu disemak, terutama jika menggunakan akaun sendiri.

why.en: Some short jobs have simple hiring. Combined with unusual financial tasks, absent screening deserves a closer look.
why.ms: Sesetengah kerja singkat mempunyai pengambilan ringkas. Jika disertai urusan wang luar biasa, ketiadaan saringan perlu diteliti.

uncertainty: This is an uncalibrated rules score, not a probability or a fraud verdict. Missing flags do not establish safety.
provenance: Local analysis. No text retained by the server. No identity, company or bank verification performed.
